source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: When this unit completes its [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move), pick a single enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range). Of the models in your charging unit, each one within [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the chosen enemy rolls a D6. A 4+ inflicts D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on the chosen unit. If this ability kills one of its models, it must attempt a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock).
